input.description: Research 4K PC monitors for coding under 700 GBP
input.prompt:
Research all available 4K PC monitors (3840x2160 resolution) from Dell, Samsung, LG, and Asus that would be suitable for coding and productivity work.

Requirements for the research:
1. Focus exclusively on 4K (3840x2160) monitors
2. Find official pricing in GBP when available, or current USD/EUR pricing that can be converted
3. Extract from official brand websites only
4. Include key specs: screen size, panel type (IPS/VA/etc), color accuracy (if available), refresh rate, ports
5. Note any special features relevant to productivity/coding (USB-C, Thunderbolt, height adjustable stands, etc.)
6. Include models both for single high-end monitors and dual monitor configurations
7. Identify which options could fit within a 700 GBP total budget for dual setups

For each model found, provide:
- Official model number with link to official product page
- Official price in GBP (or convertible currency with current rate noted)
- Screen size (in inches)
- Resolution (should all be 4K 3840x2160)
- Panel type
- Refresh rate
- Key ports (HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C, Thunderbolt, etc.)
- Color accuracy specs (DeltaE if available)
- Adjustability features (height, tilt, pivot, swivel)
- Any other productivity-relevant features

Then compile all findings into a comprehensive comparison table that includes suitability notes for coding work and budget considerations for dual monitor setups. The user wants to understand both single premium options and dual monitor combinations that work together within the 700 GBP budget.
